description: Live availability check for up to 10 domain names at once (full names such as mybrand.ae, or bare words checked with the given extensions), using the same lookup as GlobalHostia's bulk domain search. Only extensions GlobalHostia sells. Each name counts toward the limit of 10 domain checks per minute. No sign-in needed.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code such as USD or AED (default USD).
